purpose: Research on obesity among women with depression.
question: How many women aged 18 or older with depression have a latest BMI of 30 or more, by region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Depression = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with F32.
Obese = latest BMI (LOINC 39156-5) of 30 or more.
Report per region: adult women with depression, how many of them are obese and that share in %, one decimal.
